not_supported: Tachycardia is present. -- Median heart rate over the 6 h before the decision: 84 bpm (6 readings), normal by the rule 'tachycardia HR > 100; bradycardia HR < 60'.
Borderline hypotension is present. -- 'blood pressure low' holds when any component is low. systolic BP: no; mean arterial pressure: no.

The patient has an oxygen requirement. -- The patient was on nasal cannula oxygen at 2 L/min through 06:00, but at 08:00 the O2 delivery device was recorded as None, and subsequent saturations remained 97-100% without oxygen through 15:00. Thus the records show oxygen was stopped before the decision time, so the patient no longer has an oxygen requirement.
Hypomagnesemia is present (1.5 mg/dL). -- Latest magnesium 2.8 mg/dL at 2110-04-12 02:59:00 (reference 1.6 to 2.6) is high, not consistent with 'low'.
Potassium is borderline low (3.5 mEq/L). -- Latest potassium 3.5 mEq/L at 2110-04-12 02:59:00 (reference 3.3 to 5.1) is normal, not consistent with 'low'.

Friction and shear risk is present. -- The most recent Braden Friction/Shear assessments before the decision time (04:54 and 08:00 on 2110-04-12) both document 'No Apparent Problem (3)', which contradicts the claim that friction and shear risk is present.
not_addressed: The patient is currently on a multimodal pain regimen. -- The judges disagreed; the conservative label was used and the item needs human review.
The patient is currently receiving supplemental oxygen. -- No cited record shows this treatment was withheld or stopped; absence of a record is not_addressed. (Panel verdict: not_supported.)
